description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Customs Notification - Method for determination of Customs for Disposal of Machinery & Equipment imported on Re-export basis
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes a method for determining customs value for disposal of machinery imported on a re-export basis. It references the Customs (Amendment) Act, No. 2 of 2003 and creates regulatory procedures for customs valuation. The content focuses on legal/regulatory framework implementation rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
